questions.question: What are the names of the three friends?
questions.explanation: They are Kicek the rabbit, Kolczuś the hedgehog and Rudy the fox.

questions.question: Who gets the candy first?
questions.explanation: Kolczuś helps Kicek with the thorn selflessly and gets a candy.

questions.question: Why does Rudy not get candies at first?
answers: He only helps to get a reward
He does not know the tree
questions.explanation: His help is not selfless — he expects a reward.

questions.question: What does Rudy do when he finally gets the candies?
questions.explanation: He says he will share with those he helped and eat the rest together.

questions.question: When does a leaf turn into a candy?
questions.explanation: The tree reacts to Kolczuś's selfless help.
